items.summary: In BookingFormSection.tsx and BookingPage.tsx, remove the following options from the Service Timing dropdown: 'ASAP', 'Within 10 minutes', 'Within 15 MINUTES', and 'Today'. Keep only 'Within 30 minutes' and 'Within 1 hour' as valid options. Do not change any other form fields, layout, styling, animations, or functionality.

In BookingFormSection.tsx and BookingPage.tsx, remove the Live Location Tracking section/feature entirely from the booking form UI. The address input field must remain so users can manually type their address. Do not remove the IP-based auto-fill functionality for the address field (ipapi.co). Do not change any other form fields, layout, styling, animations, or functionality.
